page.layout: One column of running text, full width. Running head centred above the text, page number at the top right. No marginal notes, no footnotes. Catchword at the right below the last line.

main_text.p: gentis Chronica, quæ Arabice conversa habuit Scaliger; ex illius gentis Chronicis Hebraicis longum fragmentum refertur in fine Libri Juchasin, de magnis quibusdamRegibus trans Euphratem bellum adversum Josuam præparantibus, sed nihil Chronologiæ memini in eo me legisse. Quæ apud Scaligerum post Mo-sis mortem, ab iis adduntur, sic explicari possunt, à Mose ad reditum Sacerdotum gestantium Ephod, qui ministrant in Tabernaculo 2215 anni, summæ series erit 5047. ad diem ingressus Fanatici. Samaritani litteras gutturales sæpissime permutant; hoc fit ex perversa eorum pronunciatione, qui nullas aspirant, ideo חור & עור pronunciantes אור sæpe scriberent. Hoc Pentateuchum ipsorum Lingua & Charactere Samaritanum legens, millies expertus sum, in Pentateucho Linguâ Hebraicâ studiose evitant, id tamen ipsis nonnunquam excidere animadverti. Itaque in hoc computo singulare quoddam factum, à quâ Epochen ducunt, quodque circa Mahu-

page.notes: Hebrew words "חור & עור" and "אור" are transcribed from the scan; the vowel points over the first pair are not clearly legible, so the exact pointing is uncertain. The phrase "qvibusdamRegibus" is printed without a space and is left as printed. The last word "Mahumeti" is split: "Mahu-" ends the text and "meti" is the catchword. Printed u/v were normalised to u as a vowel and v as a consonant, as the rules require.
